main_text.p: Philo {1} item narrans Iudæos Alexandriæ in crucem actos à Flacco, hoc addit: μετὰ τὸ αἰκίσασθαι ἐν τῷ θεάτρῳ : postquam flagellati fuissent in theatro. Sollennis ergo mos, imò lex: & horrendum Carmen diserte canebat {2}: Verbera intra aut extra pomœrium: & tum denique succinebat: Arbori infelici suspendito.
main_text.head: CAP. III.

head.i: Flagellorum & Virgarum discrimen. Illa magis vilia, & magis acerba esse. solere & talis asperari.

main_text.p: Flagra cruciarius propria.Verberati igitur: sed utrùm virgis an flagellis? Illas interdum reperio: sed magis crebrò ista. Discrimen enim esse scimus: & quia Virgæ honestiores, inhonestissimo huic supplicio adtributa Flagra. Cicero

page.notes: Left margin note partly damaged; read as "Flagra cruciarius propria." Marginal word-breaks ("crucia-/rius pro-/pria") joined. Greek footnote-line text partly faint; the Greek in the text is uncertain in its final letters. The footnote "lib. r." is doubtful (possibly "lib. I." or "lib. 1.").
